scope: Marked synthetic PostgreSQL fixtures only; partial publication
inputs: validated explicit concept IDs and inclusive DATE window
frequency_inputs: Restricted CTE grouped by concept, known unit, raw operator and exact finite value; physical duplicate multiplicity retained in COUNT(*)
sum_and_n: SUM(value * frequency), SUM(frequency); exact NUMERIC text
grouping: Known positive Unit-domain concept and raw operator NULL or 0, separately; observed zero-n groups retain NULL statistics
export: Only bounded aggregate partitions and local terminology; no source rows, person IDs or frequency table
prerequisite_failure: Atomic explicit status for seven measurement outputs, no numeric rows; retain valid passport/person/observation outputs
quantile_weighted: Sort grouped exact values; cumulative SUM(frequency) with explicit ROWS frame; choose first value reaching exact integer ceil(a*n/b) rank using DIV(a*n+b-1,b). No physical expansion, self-join, FLOAT or interpolation
selection: Explicit numericStrategy=weighted; reference stays default. No universal performance promotion.
